confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for July 2026, the peak season, drawn from general knowledge and no live booking pages or current listings were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately certain; accommodation anchors are less certain and include an estimate of taxes and tourist fees. Cocktail and wine_glass were scaled from the local beer price relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation is the RBA 15 October 2026 figure, corroborated by two RBA pages. A 16 October figure appeared in a search snippet but could not be verified, so it was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized EU capitals with similar tourism demand and price levels, such as Ljubljana and Budapest, adjusted for Zagreb's Eurozone pricing and its July tourist peak.
